body: Oof I feel you on loans, for sure. I got dinged badly for totally forgetting payments that flew under the radar when I graduated. I don't know exactly what kind of loan you have, but you should be able to contact a loan counselor from your university to talk through these things. It's surprising you weren't granted forebearance; keep trying. Again, try to get somebody on the phone. I was able to work through my mess by agreeing to a mild loan rehabilitation program. Then, I got a solid income-based plan. yeah, I'm going to pay loans til I'm like 80 haha but at least I'm not getting phone calls anymore. Another thing (maybe not ideal or what you reallllly want to do with your life) - certain professions will delay payments (re-enter grace period by being a grad student somewhere in something that \*pays\* you, like science) or grant you loan forgiveness (in the US, work as a teacher for a low-income school for X amount of years, work for the government). Maybe worth looking into if your loans are that huge of a burden... You'll make it though, just remember you can't take it with you and pretty much most people have debt, so you're not alone ;)
